description: Connect iOS push by saving an APNs auth key (.p8). The key is encrypted at rest and never returned. Requires the integrations:manage scope and a role that can edit workspace settings (marketer keys cannot).

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

environment.description: production (App Store/TestFlight, default) or sandbox (Xcode development builds).

privateKey.description: Full contents of the AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8 file.

name: set_apns_credentials

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `set_apns_credentials` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
